test_title: RRB ALP CBT-II (Armature and Coil Winder) Official Paper (Held On: 06 May, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Which statement regarding Non-Functional Dimensions (NF) in engineering drawings is true?

Statement 1: Non-functional dimensions are shown as unbounded, because they do not affect the functionality of the component or space.

Statement 2: Non-functional dimensions are typically used for reference purposes only and do not affect the assembly or performance of the component or space.
solution:
The correct answer is __Only Statement 2 is true**(Option 2)**.__
